title: A down leg bases, and only one flip earns a card
premise: The plain SuperTrend flips back and forth through the base while the vote stays under 90% and nothing prints. Then one flip is confirmed: BUYERS prints, and the trend line and the Neural Line carry the move.

chapters.title: UNCONFIRMED
chapters.text: The SuperTrend flips up (line 26,476.58), where a plain SuperTrend would signal. 23% of the vote sits in a settled uptrend, under the 90% threshold, so no card prints. Flips 1 · confirmed 0.

chapters.title: UNCONFIRMED
chapters.text: The SuperTrend flips back down (line 26,527.64): a plain SuperTrend would have signalled up, then down again. The vote never confirmed the flip up, so no card and no trend line were drawn. Flips 2 · confirmed 0.

chapters.title: UNCONFIRMED
chapters.text: The SuperTrend flips up (line 26,480.39), where a plain SuperTrend would signal. 59% of the vote sits in a settled uptrend, under the 90% threshold, so no card prints. Flips 3 · confirmed 0.

chapters.title: BUYERS
chapters.text: The SuperTrend, up since 12:41, now has 91% of the vote among the 10 most similar past states in a settled uptrend — over the 90% threshold. The Neural Line agrees, so BUYERS prints: flip 3, the first confirmed.

chapters.title: STRONG UP
chapters.text: All four Spectrum SuperTrends point up and the bar ignites, so the candle brightens to strong up (cyan). The trend line and the Neural Line hold the long side.
